Please answer the following questions related to Internet of Things (IoT).

(a) What are the information privacy issues of IoT? Why these issues are important? Please give two examples from different application domains (e.g., smart manufacturing, smart city, smart home, smart vehicle, etc.) to illustrate information privacy threat (risk). (12%)

(b) What are object safety and security issues in IoT? Why these issues are important? Please give two examples from different application domains (e.g., smart manufacturing, smart city, smart home, smart vehicle, etc.) to illustrate object safety and security threat (risk). (12%)
